source: LXCat, www.lxcat.net (SIGLO database). SIGLO database is the electron-impact cross-section source of Chen et al., Phys. Plasmas 32, 113502 (2025), ref 22. Re-sourced from the project crossbrowser export lxcat_excited_ar_ne.json, SIGLO process id SIGLO__Ne_3P2__Ionization__583.
comment: Ionization from metastable level, J. Meunier, Ph. Belenguer and J.P. Boeuf, J. Appl. Phys. 78, 731 (1995)extrapolation after 220 eV using ln(energy)/energy. SIGLO dataset (Chen 2025, ref 22); re-sourced from crossbrowser lxcat_excited_ar_ne.json, source id SIGLO__Ne_3P2__Ionization__583. Metastable-target (stepwise) ionization used for arf.toml R4, e + Ne* -> Ne+ + 2 e. SOURCE TARGET STRING: "Ne(3P2)"; recorded here as target "Ne*" because that is how the project species registry and arf.toml spell the lumped Ne metastable, and match_record_to_reaction (src/reactions/cross_sections.py) requires the dataset target to be one of the TOML reactants. This is consistent with arf.toml R1, which already represents the same lumped Ne* by the SIGLO Ne 3P2 excitation set (e_Ne_excitation_1, source id SIGLO__Ne__Excitation__25). The tabulated numbers, threshold, param and updated stamp are unchanged from the source. Cross section stored in m^2 by SIGLO (converted to cm^2 for the CSV column).
